title: Mellin-Space Prony Representability of Linear Viscoelastic Models
summary: Linear viscoelastic materials are commonly described by continuous relaxation spectra, yet practical measurements and simulations employ discrete Prony series. In the Laplace frequency domain, the distinction is well understood: rational transfer functions admit finite Prony representations, while fractional models with branch cuts do not. This work provides a complementary and structurally deeper characterization in the Mellin transform domain.
